purpose: Historical reliability analysis of remote commands for the workspace-selected vehicle and date range.
primaryGoal: Compare confidence-weighted success by command, identify unreliable operations and retry effort, and inspect recorded outcomes without mistaking a small sample for proven reliability.

dataSources.sourceOwner: commandHandler.CommandHistory; backend handler/repository internals not inspected
dataSources.scope: Selected vehicle; from=startInstant and to=endInstantExclusive; limit=1000; before_created_at/before_id cursor.
dataSources.queryContract: commandKeys.reliability normalizes vehicle identity to string; key includes vehicle, reliability, from and to. enabled requires vehicle/from/to; staleTime=STALE_TIMES.QUICK. Query signal is forwarded to every request. All cursor pages are collected before success; invalid arrays/nonadvancing cursors throw.
dataSources.payload: CommandLogEntry[]: id, vehicle_id, command, params, status, error, created_at.
dataSources.backendLimits: Router comment specifies RFC3339 [from,to) or legacy inclusive calendar dates. Actual SQL filtering, cursor ordering, permissions and completeness were not exercised or inspected.
dataSources.confidence: high for source wiring; runtime unverified

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect fleet source via useVehicles; its endpoint implementation was not inspected.
dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing workspace vehicle store, URL synchronization and fleet query.
dataSources.scope: URL vehicle_id/path identity, then persisted valid selection, then first known vehicle; no page-local picker.
dataSources.preserve: Do not replace workspace selection or mutate its persistence/URL precedence.

dataSources.scope: defaultAnalysisRange, vehicle timezone and RFC3339 instant bounds; route is in RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS at web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:36.
dataSources.preserve: Rolling/custom range, URL from/to, shared preferences and timezone/DST semantics. Do not add a second date or vehicle selector.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing pure command reliability domain analysis.
dataSources.behavior: Skip invalid timestamps/empty commands; classify success/pending/failure; exclude pending from success/Wilson denominators; collapse consecutive attempts separated by at most five minutes; normalize error signatures; calculate Wilson 95% intervals, minimum-five-resolved grading and lower-bound ordering. No new measurements or server calculations.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: ComponentProps<typeof PageContainer>; forwards title/subtitle/query and children; min-w-0, full-width container. Query supplies freshness metadata, not automatic body error/loading gating.

components.name: OperationalBrief with useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: eyebrow/title/description/statusLabel/metrics; compact/loading/scope/freshness/provenance/statusTone; metric rawValue and valueState retain source measurements. Review details opens the existing drawer. Current useOperationalMetrics uses useUnits/useFormatting and formatOperationalMetrics.
components.decision: reuse; do not recreate KPI cards or another summary drawer

components.name: ChartContainer
components.contract: title/subtitle/ariaLabel, loading/error/onRetry/empty, size/height/mobileHeight, data/dataColumns fallback table, separate exportData CSV scope, default PNG/SVG/copy-image menu. Fullscreen and persisted interactive legend are opt-in and not enabled here.
dependsOn: existing category-exported chart primitives and ChartTooltip
components.decision: reuse existing error, accessible table, export and responsive APIs; no replacement chart/export library

components.name: useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning
components.contract: state with hasData/fatalError/refreshError/isRefreshBlocked/retry. Historical retained data survives refresh errors/offline pauses; warning is a polite status and retry is disabled while refreshing. No retained payload means warning renders nothing.
components.decision: reuse; apply fatal versus empty distinction consistently in every section

components.name: GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, Badge, HelpTooltip
components.contract: Shared surface, semantic headings/text, localized explanation triggers and success/info/warning/danger/neutral grade labels; implementations other than consumers were not inspected.
dependsOn: existing semantic tokens and UI category
components.decision: reuse; replace fixed feature accent classes with existing theme-aware semantic presentation

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: children, optional delay/className; useMotionPreference supplies reduce and durationMs, reduced mode uses initial=false and delay=0.
dependsOn: existing useMotionPreference; hook implementation not inspected
components.decision: reuse; source support is not exercised reduced-motion acceptance

components.name: NoVehicleSelected
components.contract: pageTitle, optional title/description; shared vehicles.list guidance and setup action fallback /onboarding.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Confidence-empty rendering bypasses ChartContainer into a separate GlassPanel; command detail has another separately gated empty surface. The same history trust decision is scattered across summary/chart/detail.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse ChartContainer empty/error props and derive section state once from shared DataState; preserve both explanations and all three section identities.

sourceObservations: PageLayout supplies min-w-0 and a full-width @container.
Details stack in one column until lg, then two; label/value cells use two columns until sm then four; headings wrap.
Chart uses ResponsiveContainer but fixed height=380 and YAxis width=150 with 10px ticks.

findings.detail: A fixed 150px label rail plus chart margins consumes much of a 320px allocated canvas; 10px category ticks and a fixed-height many-command chart have no page-specific dense/long-label strategy. Actual clipping was not observed.
findings.fix: Use existing responsive frame size/mobileHeight and container-aware axis layout; preserve full names in tooltip/fallback table and every command. Test many commands and long labels rather than dropping rows.
findings.confidence: medium; source risk, not measured overflow

findings.detail: Source error text is placed in a grid cell without explicit wrapping for long unbroken signatures. Analyzer caps signatures at 120 characters but they can still be unbroken.
findings.fix: Add existing wrapping/min-width utilities to value cells and test long identifiers/errors at narrow widths and 200% text; retain the entire source signature and count.

sourceStrengths: Named metric section, shared PanelTitle and Text, explicit chart ariaLabel and dataColumns, text grade labels alongside color.
Detail heading icon is aria-hidden and both HelpTooltip calls have localized accessible names.
Shared stale warning provides role=status/aria-live=polite and existing retry; FadeIn delegates reduced motion.

findings.detail: Command facts are sibling Text label/value nodes in a visual grid rather than explicitly associated definition pairs. Heading/list identify the command, but label/value relationships are not encoded as dt/dd.
findings.fix: Keep the command list and use semantic dl/dt/dd through Text.as for each existing field; retain keyboard-accessible shared help and chart alternatives.
findings.confidence: high for markup; assistive-technology impact unverified

states.initialLoading: OperationalBrief loading, chart loading and detail Skeleton are wired to historyQuery.isLoading.
states.success: Four summary metrics, confidence/raw-rate chart and all command detail rows.
states.empty: Summary says No attempts recorded, chart area becomes explanatory EmptyState, detail says No commands recorded.
states.fatalFailure: Summary has QueryError/refetch; chart/detail currently look empty because their fatal branches are incomplete.
states.staleOrOfflineWithRetainedData: Shared historical DataState and StaleRefreshWarning preserve query payload; summary statusTone=warning for stale.
states.initialOfflineWithoutData: Source risk: isLoading can be false for a pending paused query; summary says unavailable but chart/detail can claim empty. No paused query was exercised.
states.noSelectedVehicle: Existing NoVehicleSelected onboarding guidance replaces the analysis.

findings.detail: On initial history failure, summary renders retry but ChartContainer receives no error/onRetry and empty=true. Detail line 241 also tests only command count. An unavailable source therefore produces empty/no-records messaging beside a fatal error.
findings.fix: Pass state.fatalError and state.retry to ChartContainer; give detail a fatal failure branch before resolved-empty. Derive initial/paused/available state from DataState instead of treating data??[] as evidence of no records. Keep retained content on refresh failure.

findings.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-033 / unknown is not zero
findings.detail: A successfully loaded empty or pending-only history gets summary.overallSuccessRate=0 (analyzer lines 276 and 316-317), so the overall metric presents 0% without resolved evidence. A null worstCommand also uses Nothing failing at line 92 even for empty/unproven records.
findings.fix: Keep cached payload and analytical calculations unchanged; supply a missing/no-resolved-evidence presentation value when there are no success+failure attempts and an evidence-qualified context for empty/unproven worstCommand. Preserve measured zero when resolved failures actually exist.

visualIssues.detail: Numeric grade-to-palette indexing disagrees with Badge semantics: excellent uses series[2] amber, flaky series[3] red, unreliable series[5] cyan, unproven series[7] lime; the raw marker is also lime and the 95% reference is amber. tokens.ts:401 confirms these concrete hues. This creates mixed semantic cues and more color than needed, not a claim that chartTokens itself is forbidden.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer one restrained neutral lower-bound fill and a distinct subdued raw marker, retaining grade meaning in existing semantic Badges and the fallback grade column; alternatively reuse current semantic fills aligned with Badge meanings. Make the reference line neutral/dashed with an explanation. Do not change saved theme palettes or invent feature hex colors.

visualIssues.detail: Heading decoration uses fixed text-cyan-300 and failure body uses fixed text-rose-300 at line 295, unlike the theme-aware primary/muted surrounding text. Light/custom-theme composed contrast was not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted typography color for the decorative heading icon and a theme-aware semantic danger treatment for actual failure text. Preserve textual failure meaning/count and verify contrast on composed backgrounds.
visualIssues.confidence: high for fixed classes; contrast unverified

architectureIssues.detail: Display labels are truncated before becoming chartData.command, fallback table identity and Cell key (line 212). Distinct long commands can share a truncated key; assistive table text loses the full name even though the detail list retains it.
architectureIssues.fix: Carry raw command as stable identity and full humanized label in data/export rows; truncate only the axis formatter. Retain all existing fields, ordering and chart/detail consistency.

architectureIssues.detail: The variable named exportData is only passed as ChartContainer.data. Shared ChartContainer:145-146,417-422 requires its separate exportData prop to enable CSV; this page currently has image-export menu source wiring but not CSV wiring. Existing CSV availability must not be claimed.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current PNG/SVG/copy-image capabilities and fallback table. If exposing the already-prepared tabular rows as CSV is intended, explicitly pass complete full-label exportData to the existing API; this is a page integration improvement, not proof CSV already worked.

architectureIssues.detail: Range caption uses vehicle timezone at line 133, but Last used and freshness line 142 omit tz; inspected dateFormat.ts:8-13 explicitly defaults omitted options to browser timezone. The display can disagree at a timezone boundary.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass the same vehicle timezone to command dates/freshness via existing formatters; retain RFC3339 source instants and selected [from,to) bounds without changing saved timezone/range preferences.

priority.rationale: Prioritize truthful fatal/empty/paused and no-resolved-evidence presentation, stable full-name chart identity and semantic palette alignment. Responsive/contrast observations remain source risks pending QA.
order: full command identities and fallback evidence

notes: Existing OperationalBrief/stat formatting, PageLayout, ChartContainer, DataState and workspace hooks already cover the concrete needs inspected here.
No new shared component or palette contract is justified by this single-page audit. Reuse contracts above; proposed changes are caller/domain-adapter fixes.
No unrelated consumer survey was performed and no global duplication count is claimed.

data: Full-range cursor history, abort signal, normalized query identity, existing enablement/stale/retry policy and selected vehicle bounds.
All raw CommandLogEntry fields remain unchanged on wire/cache; historical provenance and retained-data refresh semantics survive.

Success and pending classifications, Wilson 95% formula, thresholds/minimum evidence, consecutive five-minute retry grouping, error-signature normalization and least-trustworthy-first ordering remain domain-owned.
Keep zero resolved success distinct from no resolved evidence at presentation boundary, without rewriting status semantics or inventing measurements.
Preserve four metrics, every command row, interval/raw/upper/attempt/grade fallback columns and every specialist help explanation.
Dimensionless rates/counts and UTC timestamps remain source values; no new legacy physical-unit conversions. Do not change existing retry-window option units in a presentation migration.
No enabled fullscreen, annotation, chart zoom or persisted legend-toggle capability is evidenced at this page call; do not invent preservation claims for absent props.
